unassigned_nodes.essential_nature: Innovation in Torah — the Rebbe urges study and chiddush as a spiritual practice. It is the cause side of the single eitza edge in this Torah. The teaching identifies it as a bechina of 'medame milta l'milta' (drawing Torah analogies), meaning it channels the imaginative faculty toward holiness. No bechina packages exist in this Torah to assign it to.

Rectification of sinful thoughts — the positive outcome produced by innovating in Torah. Since all hirhurim come from the koach hamedameh (imaginative faculty), channeling that faculty into Torah chiddush repairs its damage. No bechina packages exist in this Torah to assign it to.
